wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# EAVI College Management System - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## Project Introduction

The EAVI College Management System is a comprehensive web-based educational management platform designed for East Africa Vision Institute (EAVI), a technical and vocational education institution based in Eldoret, Kenya. This Next.js application provides a unified digital ecosystem for managing admissions, student enrollment, academic records, fee management, and administrative operations across multiple campuses.

### Purpose Statement
The system aims to streamline administrative processes, enhance student experience, and provide real-time data analytics for institutional decision-making while maintaining compliance with Kenyan technical education standards.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Digital Transformation**: Modernize traditional paper-based administrative processes
- **Multi-Campus Support**: Manage operations across Main, West, and Town campuses
- **Fee Management Automation**: Streamline tuition payment processing and tracking
- **Academic Record Keeping**: Maintain comprehensive student academic history
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Provide administrators with actionable insights

### Target Audience
- **Administrators**: Academic staff managing student records and academic calendars
- **Students**: Learners accessing course materials, results, and payment portals
- **Lecturers**: Faculty members managing course assignments and exam results
- **Finance Department**: Staff handling fee collections and financial reporting

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern full-stack architecture built on Next.js 16 with server-side rendering and TypeScript for enhanced development experience.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Client Browser] --> B[Next.js App Router]
    B --> C[Middleware Layer]
    C --> D[Supabase Authentication]
    D --> E[Database Layer]
    B --> F[Component Rendering]
    F --> G[React Components]
    G --> H[UI Library - shadcn/ui]
    E --> I[PostgreSQL Database]
    I --> J[Supabase Tables]
    J --> K[Applications]
    J --> L[Students]
    J --> M[Fees]
    J --> N[Results]
```

### Component Breakdown

The application is structured around a clear separation of concerns:

**Frontend Layer**: Next.js App Router with React Server Components and Client Components
**Authentication Layer**: Supabase Auth with role-based access control
**Data Layer**: PostgreSQL database with Supabase ORM
**API Layer**: RESTful endpoints for file uploads and PDF generation
**Presentation Layer**: Tailwind CSS with custom theming and responsive design

### Design Patterns

The system implements several key design patterns:

- **Repository Pattern**: Abstracted database operations through Supabase client
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic component creation for different user roles
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates through Supabase realtime features
- **Strategy Pattern**: Multiple fee calculation strategies for different course types

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Application Root** (`app/page.tsx`)
- Primary landing page showcasing institution branding and navigation
- Responsive design with hero section, program showcase, and campus information
- Integrated call-to-action buttons for admissions and portal access

**Authentication System** (`lib/middleware.ts`)
- Centralized authentication middleware with role-based redirection
- Session validation and automatic login redirection for unauthorized access
- Support for multi-campus user management

### Core Modules

**Database Schema** (`database.sql`)
- Comprehensive schema supporting 15+ tables including applications, courses, fees, and results
- Multi-campus support with campus-specific constraints and relationships
- Academic calendar integration for term scheduling and exam management

**Fee Calculation Engine** (`lib/fee-calculation.ts`)
- Sophisticated fee calculation logic supporting multiple exam bodies (KNEC, JP, CDACC, Internal)
- Pro-rata calculations for bridge students with holiday class fee integration
- Installment planning and late fee calculation algorithms

**PDF Generation System** (`components/AdmissionLetter.tsx`)
- Dynamic PDF generation using pdfmake for admission letters and fee structures
- Support for custom branding with header images and institutional stamps
- Modular fee structure presentation with detailed payment breakdowns

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Configuration** (`lib/client.ts`, `lib/server.ts`)
- Separate client and server Supabase clients for security and performance optimization
- Environment variable management for Supabase credentials and application settings
- Cookie-based authentication with proper serialization for server-side rendering

**Build Configuration** (`next.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`)
- TypeScript configuration with strict mode enabled
- Tailwind CSS integration with custom font management
- PostCSS configuration for advanced styling capabilities

### External Dependencies

**Core Dependencies**:
- `@supabase/supabase-js`: Real-time database and authentication
- `next`: React framework with App Router and server-side rendering
- `pdfmake`: PDF generation for academic documents
- `lucide-react`: Consistent iconography across the application
- `tailwind-merge`: Utility class combination for responsive design

**Development Dependencies**:
- `typescript`: Type safety and enhanced developer experience
- `eslint`: Code quality and consistency enforcement
- `@tailwindcss/postcss`: Advanced Tailwind CSS features

### Integration Points

**Supabase Integration** (`lib/server.ts`, `lib/client.ts`)
- Real-time database subscriptions for live updates
- File storage integration for document management
- Authentication hooks for seamless user experience

**Third-Party Services**:
- Vercel Blob Storage for file uploads and document management
- Custom PDF generation pipeline for academic documentation
- Email integration for automated notifications and alerts

### Component Relationship Diagrams

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Admin Dashboard] --> B[Application Management]
    A --> C[Student Records]
    A --> D[Fee Management]
    A --> E[Academic Calendar]
    
    B --> F[Admission Processing]
    B --> G[Enrollment Tracking]
    
    C --> H[Grade Management]
    C --> I[Attendance Records]
    
    D --> J[Payment Processing]
    D --> K[Financial Reporting]
    
    E --> L[Exam Scheduling]
    E --> M[Academic Terms]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Multi-Roles User System**:
- Admin portal with comprehensive management capabilities
- Student dashboard for academic progress and payment tracking
- Lecturer interface for grade submission and course management

**Advanced Fee Management**:
- Dynamic fee calculation based on course type, exam body, and student status
- Installment plan creation with automatic payment tracking
- Late fee calculation and financial hold management

**Academic Record Management**:
- Comprehensive grade tracking across multiple semesters and modules
- Exam scheduling integration with academic calendar
- Transcript generation and verification systems

### Implementation Highlights

**Fee Calculation Engine** (`lib/fee-calculation.ts`)
- Supports four different exam bodies (KNEC, JP, CDACC, Internal)
- Handles complex fee structures with practical, exam, and registration components
- Bridge student pro-rata calculations with holiday class fee integration

**PDF Generation Pipeline** (`components/AdmissionLetter.tsx`)
- Dynamic document generation with institutional branding
- Support for multiple fee structure types (semester, module, short-course)
- Automated reporting date integration and payment detail customization

**Real-Time Notifications** (`app/admin/dashboard/page.tsx`)
- Live exam submission notifications for lecturers
- Payment activity monitoring with automated alerts
- Campus-specific data filtering and reporting

### Feature Architecture Diagrams

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ApplicationSubmission
    ApplicationSubmission --> PendingReview: Submit Application
    PendingReview --> Approved: Admin Approval
    PendingReview --> Rejected: Incomplete/Unqualified
    Approved --> Enrollment: Payment Verified
    Enrollment --> ActiveStudent: Academic Term Start
    ActiveStudent --> Graduated: Program Completion
    ActiveStudent --> Suspended: Financial Hold
    Suspended --> ActiveStudent: Payment Resolved
    
    note right of PendingReview
        Multi-stage review process
        Includes academic eligibility
        Verification checks
    end note
```

**Payment Processing Flow**:
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Student
    participant Portal
    participant PaymentSystem
    participant Bank
    participant Database
    
    Student->>+Portal: Make Payment
    Portal->>+PaymentSystem: Process Transaction
    PaymentSystem->>+Bank: Validate Payment
    Bank-->>-PaymentSystem: Payment Confirmation
    PaymentSystem->>+Database: Update Payment Status
    Database-->>-PaymentSystem: Success Response
    PaymentSystem-->>-Portal: Payment Complete
    Portal-->>-Student: Receipt Generated
```

**Fee Calculation Workflow**:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Student Registration] --> B{Course Type}
    B -->|Diploma/Certificate| C[Standard Fee Calculation]
    B -->|Short Course| D[Short Course Fee Calculation]
    B -->|Bridge Program| E[Bridge Student Calculation]
    
    C --> F[Module Selection]
    F --> G[Semester Selection]
    G --> H[Additional Fees]
    H --> I[Total Calculation]
    
    D --> J[First Installment]
    J --> K[Subsequent Installments]
    K --> L[Practical Fees]
    L --> I
    
    E --> M[Pro-Rata Calculation]
    M --> N[Holiday Class Fees]
    N --> O[Final Adjustment]
    O --> I
```

---

**Sources:**
- [package.json](package.json)
- [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx)
- [lib/middleware.ts](lib/middleware.ts)
- [lib/client.ts](lib/client.ts)
- [lib/server.ts](lib/server.ts)
- [components/AdmissionLetter.tsx](components/AdmissionLetter.tsx)
- [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx)
- [app/admin/dashboard/page.tsx](app/admin/dashboard/page.tsx)
- [lib/fee-calculation.ts](lib/fee-calculation.ts)
- [database.sql](database.sql)
- [app/login/layout.tsx](app/login/layout.tsx)
- [components/PaymentReceipt.tsx](components/PaymentReceipt.tsx)
- [app/api/admission-pdf/route.ts](app/api/admission-pdf/route.ts)

</blog>
